title: Broken Access Control
description: Restrictions on what authenticated users are allowed to do are often not properly enforced.
mitigation: Enforce principle of least privilege, deny access by default, and implement rate limiting.

title: Injection (SQL, NoSQL, OS Command)
description: User-supplied data is not validated, filtered, or sanitized by the application before execution.
mitigation: Use parameterized queries, object-relational mapping (ORM) libraries, and input validation allowlists.

title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
description: Attackers exploit API endpoints that are vulnerable to broken object level authorization by manipulating the ID of an object sent within the request.
mitigation: Validate user authorization policies against each requested object ID.

title: Broken Object Property Level Authorization (BOPLA)
description: Lack of or improper validation of object properties exposed through API endpoints.
mitigation: Enforce schema validation, reject unknown properties, and avoid mass assignment.
